usages.explain: Expresses an action being done towards the speaker or the person the speaker is addressing. The doer of the action is indicated by the particle [が], and the recipient of the action is indicated by [...に].

examples.content: 隣人がうちの騒音について文句を言って来た。
examples.transcription: りんじんがうちのそうおんについてもんくをいってきた。
examples.mean: My neighbor complained about the noise from my house.

examples.content: 急に猫が飛びかかってきた。
examples.transcription: きゅうにねこがとびかかってきた。
examples.mean: Suddenly a cat jumped on me.

examples.content: 会社から地方の名物の注文を依頼して来た。
examples.transcription: かいしゃからちほうのめいぶつのちゅうもんをいらいしてきた。
examples.mean: The company asked me to order a local specialty.

examples.content: 日本から援助品が送られて来た。
examples.transcription: にっぽんからえんじょひんがおくられてきた。
examples.mean: Aid goods were sent from Japan.

usages.explain: Note: When the subject of the action is a noun expressing a place, such as 会社 (company)..., it will be indicated by the particle [...から]. There are also cases where the action is expressed in the passive form. In such cases, the doer of the action goes with the particle [...から], and the recipient of the action goes with the particle [...に].

title: てくる => to do… and come back; to become, to start ~
